origin_master_prompt.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: entirely redesigned Han Seoyun MASTER, ONE full-body transparent sprite for this adult Korean office-romance VN. The user REJECTED her prior art style and explicitly requested a complete rebuild with a mature married-woman/'misi' mood and a genuinely fuller, voluptuous adult figure. INPUTS 1, 2, 3 ARE ART STYLE REFERENCES of the other three heroines, not identities or poses to copy. Match their precise clean anime VN linework, clear cel-like form shadows softened by restrained painterly gradients, polished hair highlight groups, eyelash/iris treatment, fabric shading and unified neutral studio palette. Do NOT use the previous Seoyun picture or its more realistic mottled fabric rendering. Design a DISTINCT Korean adult woman who reads as late-thirties/early-forties in visual maturity: rounded adult cheeks, a softly broad mature jaw instead of a pointed schoolgirl chin, slightly hooded warm brown almond eyes that are smaller and more relaxed than the young blonde reference, modest natural lips, faint lower-eyelid shading and subtle smile lines, warm self-assured knowing closed-mouth smile. No old-age caricature or heavy wrinkles. Chestnut-brown hair in a loose LOW bun near the nape, softly parted fringe, a few curved cheek-framing locks; small pearl studs and a simple silver watch with dark strap. Her body MUST be noticeably fuller than all three style references: naturally substantial bust within clothing, soft waist with real thickness rather than a tiny pinched waist, broad rounded hips, thick thighs, fuller upper arms and soft belly contour. Balanced convincing anatomy and confident mature posture, not just oversized breasts on a skinny body. Attractive adult everyday sensuality, fully clothed, no lingerie. Wardrobe: soft light-blue cotton open-collar blouse with visible simple seams and gentle tension/folds over her fuller torso, ivory scoop-neck inner layer, a neatly draped TAUPE fine-knit cardigan ending around upper thigh with understated rib edges (no noisy hyperreal knit texture), warm-ivory high-waisted tailored straight trousers following her fuller hip/thigh silhouette, BLACK LEATHER LOAFERS with a very low heel, not pumps. Keep cloth crisp and harmonious in the SAME illustration style as the supplied heroines. Neutral baseline pose: comfortable upright standing, torso slightly three-quarter, no crossed legs. A slim dark tablet is held vertically low beside her left hip by her left hand; her right hand rests naturally at the side of her waist, elbow not dramatically flared. Calm adult gaze facing the viewer, confident and approachable, not coy or shy. Anatomically clear adult-size hands and fingers. Vertical 1024x1536 full-body framing, entire hair and both shoes visible, modest margin, approximately eight-head-tall mature figure rather than elongated supermodel legs. Genuine transparent alpha background; no black or white backdrop, no halo, gradient, colored fringe, floor, shadow or checkerboard. One coherent single illustration, no text, panels or watermark. Do not clone any reference heroine's face, hairstyle or outfit. No new wedding ring or family objects; this is a visual design, not a story-status change.
